quotations.old_english: Ðá genam hé ða máðmfatu, gyldene and sylfrene, binnon Godes temple
Ða mádmfatu ðæs temples ungeríme, gyldene and sylfrene, mid óðrum goldhordum
Ðá Ælfréd king forlét his mádmes and mádmfaten

source_text: máðum-fæt, es; n. A costly vessel :-- Máððumfæt mǽre, Beo. Th. 4801; B. 2405. Ðá genam hé ða máðmfatu, gyldene and sylfrene, binnon Godes temple, Homl. Th. ii. 432, 25. Ða mádmfatu ðæs temples ungeríme, gyldene and sylfrene, mid óðrum goldhordum, 66, 7. [Ðá Ælfréd king forlét his mádmes and mádmfaten, Shrn, 16, 10.]
